HOTFIX 13
Remove unwinds every recorded UNCANNY install layer for the exact selected target.
Changed generated logs such as ReShade.log no longer block restore; real original/user-file conflicts remain protected.
The official UNCANNY logo is back in the launcher UI as an inline vector.
Adaptive Realism exposes OFF / LOW / BALANCED / HIGH / INSANE.
New installs seed INSANE + Reference Stack.
OFF is a real bypass; higher levels scale the complete source-bounded reference-look stack.
Depth-aware contact occlusion, bounded diffuse/specular response, exposure adaptation, local contrast and meso clarity are stronger.
Motion Guard and Ghosting Guard remain authoritative. X2.5 retains the lowest temporal-history weight.
